## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks run and any remaining limitations.

## Documentation review

- [ ] Project-authored prose uses clear, grammatical English.
- [ ] Public API help explains inputs, outputs, units, defaults and side effects.
- [ ] Scientific explanations define equations and assumptions, cite verified
      sources, and distinguish implementation choices from published theory.
- [ ] Examples, links and affected package/editor checks have been verified.

See [the contributor documentation baseline](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
